title: Comorbidity between depression and anxiety: assessing the role of bridge mental states in dynamic psychological networks
limitations: - Small sample sizes in single disorder groups; - Limited temporal resolution of the VAR model; - Potential confounding by unmeasured variables; - Group-level analyses may not capture individual differences.
notes: The data are not freely available in a public repository due to GDPR restrictions, but can be requested via the NESDA Data Access Committee. The code and syntax are available on OSF.
